name: Forum
looksLike: a website with topics and replies from members
people asking questions in discussion threads
a board of conversations grouped by category
definition: A website for structured discussions, organized into topics and threads with replies, where people can ask questions, share knowledge, and return to ongoing conversations.
goal: Help members find and participate in useful discussions.
audience: People discussing a shared subject or seeking help

sections.name: Categories and search
sections.purpose: Help readers find the right area before starting a topic.

sections.name: Topic list
sections.purpose: Show titles, activity, and readable status indicators.

sections.name: Discussion thread
sections.purpose: Show authors, replies, and navigation through the discussion.

sections.name: Post and moderate
sections.purpose: Make replying, reporting, and community rules clear.

prompts.short: Build a forum with searchable categories, topic lists, readable threads, replies, and moderation tools.
prompts.detailed: Build a forum website for people discussing a shared subject or seeking help. Help members find and participate in useful discussions. Include categories and search, topic list, discussion thread, post and moderate. Use responsive layouts, clear labels, keyboard access, and visible focus. Clear community rules.
